name: Hydep Frame Assembly — 3D Demo
description: Built-in showcase project demonstrating manual steps, reference images and step-by-step 3D assembly animation.

steps.name: Pick & load Frame Base
steps.instruction: Pick and load the Frame Base on the fixture with the help of the manipulator.

steps.name: Scan QR Code
steps.instruction: Scan the QR Code with the hand-held scanner.

steps.name: Place Frame Gasket Cathode
steps.instruction: Pick the Frame Gasket Cathode and place it on the frame base.

steps.name: Place Manifold Gasket
steps.instruction: Pick the manifold gasket and place it on the frame base.

steps.name: Place Frame Cover
steps.instruction: Pick the Frame Cover and place it on the frame base.

steps.name: Move barcode to placard
steps.instruction: Remove the Bar Code from the Frame Cover and stick it on the placard.

steps.name: Movement to next station
steps.instruction: Move the completed assembly to the next station.
